title: Audiodidact Cloud Platform Architecture
summary: The system processes repository architecture diagrams into spoken developer tours. Web clients communicate with an API gateway that routes requests to the diagram analysis pipeline, narration synthesizer, and knowledge base agent. Async tasks are queued through Redis to worker nodes, backed by PostgreSQL and object storage.

nodes.label: Next.js Web Application
nodes.description: User interface providing the keyboard-accessible tour player, live transcript, and voice interactions.

nodes.label: API Gateway
nodes.description: Validates requests, manages rate limits, and routes traffic to internal microservices.

nodes.label: Diagram Analysis Service
nodes.description: Extracts structured graphs from repository architecture images using multimodal vision models.

nodes.label: Narration Planner Service
nodes.description: Generates hierarchical tour scripts and dispatches speech synthesis requests.

nodes.label: Redis Task Queue
nodes.description: Buffers background audio generation and heavy image processing tasks.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database
nodes.description: Stores user sessions, tour metadata, and extracted diagram graphs.

nodes.label: Spaces Object Storage
nodes.description: Caches source diagram images, generated audio segments, and serialized knowledge files.
